items.title: First oil well drilled
items.description: Drake strikes oil in Pennsylvania, launching the modern petroleum industry

items.title: Incandescent light bulb
items.description: Edison's practical electric light transforms daily life

items.title: First nuclear electricity
items.description: EBR-1 reactor lights four bulbs in Idaho

items.title: Practical solar cell
items.description: Bell Labs produces the first silicon photovoltaic cell

fact: These four milestones trace the evolution of human energy, from petroleum and electric light to the atomic age and the rise of solar technology.
